glyph_origin: Li Shoukui (2016): Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 聿 (“brush”) + phonetic 規. 規 (“compass”) appears in the oracle bone script in its pictographic protoform resembling a 乂. During the Western Zhou period, 周 was added as seen in the bronze inscriptions. Traditionally explained as an ideogrammic compound of 聿 ("brush") + 画 ("a field (田) enclosed on four sides"). However, the ancient scripts do not depict a field.
senses: [huà] to write; to draw; to paint
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 畫; s_page_origin explains the simplified 画.
